description.zh: 工单附件Key，补充当前工单信息。可通过调用接口[GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The key of the attachment that provides more instructions for the ticket. You can call the [GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~) operation to obtain the attachment key.

description.zh: 业务背景，描述提工单的原因，以减少沟通成本。
description.en: The purpose or objective of the ticket. This parameter helps reduce unnecessary communication.
The ID of the parent ticket.
The stakeholders involved in this operation.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The tenant ID.

> To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.
